camel_example:
aliyun dyplsapi BindAxbFixedLine --region cn-hangzhou --TelB '手机号：182****2371
固话：0571******36' --TelA '手机号：182****2371
固话：0571******36' --AppId 'FC10000016848****' --Subts 20161114143116 --Expiration 60 --OrderId '123*******' --Anucode '1,2,3' --BindType mode101 --Ts 20161114143116123 --version 2017-05-25 --method POST --force
description_en: Attaches an AXB privacy number to a fixed line to restrict the calling relationship to a one-to-one relationship, allowing User A to contact User B through the fixed-line intermediate number X, and User B to contact User A through the same intermediate number X. Fixed-line privacy numbers are currently available by invitation only. Contact your technical support to activate the service and obtain integration support
description_zh: 固话绑定AXB隐私号，是将拨打关系限定在一对一关系中，用户A可以通过固话中间号码X联系到用户B，用户B也可以通过中间号码X联系到用户A。固话隐私号目前为邀约制，请联系您的技术支持进行服务开通，并提供对接支持
kebab_example:
aliyun dyplsapi bind-axb-fixed-line --app-id 'FC10000016848****' --ts 20161114143116123 --bind-type mode101 --order-id '123*******' --tela '手机号：182****2371
固话：0571******36' --telb '手机号：182****2371
固话：0571******36' --subts 20161114143116 --anucode 1,2,3 --expiration 60 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindAxbFixedLine

parameters.help_en: The ID of the number pool
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The business timestamp. The format is yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. The time is in UTC+8 and uses the 24-hour clock, accurate to milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 业务时间戳，格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS，时间采用北京时间，24小时制，精确至毫秒
parameters.name: ts

parameters.help_en:
The binding type. Valid values:

mode101: The customer specifies Number X.

mode102: The platform allocates Number X
parameters.help_zh:
绑定类型，取值：

mode101：客户指定X号码。

mode102：平台分配X号码
parameters.name: bind_type

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the message request
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
Number A of the fixed-line AXB privacy number.

Number A can be a mobile phone number or a fixed-line number. For a fixed-line number, add the area code. No hyphen is required between the area code and the fixed-line number. 
If your business requires modifying a bound number, you can call the UpdateAxbBindFixedLine (https://api.aliyun.com/document/Dyplsapi/2017-05-25/UpdateAxbBindFixedLine) operation
parameters.help_zh:
固话AXB隐私号的A号码。

A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话请加区号，区号和固定电话之间不需要连字符。 
如果您的业务需要修改已绑定的号码，可以调用UpdateAxbBindFixedLine (https://api.aliyun.com/document/Dyplsapi/2017-05-25/UpdateAxbBindFixedLine)接口进行修改
parameters.name: tela

parameters.help_en:
Number X of the fixed-line AXB privacy number. Number X is a privacy number that you have purchased (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy) in the console.

This parameter is required when the customer specifies Number X (that is, the BindType parameter is set to mode101)
parameters.help_zh:
固话AXB隐私号的X号码。X号码是您在控制台已购买的隐私号 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy)。

客户指定X号码模式下（即BindType参数为mode101），本参数必填
parameters.name: telx

parameters.help_en:
Number B of the fixed-line AXB privacy number.

Number B can be a mobile phone number or a fixed-line number. For a fixed-line number, add the area code. No hyphen is required between the area code and the fixed-line number.
If your business requires modifying a bound number, you can call the UpdateAxbBindFixedLine (https://api.aliyun.com/document/Dyplsapi/2017-05-25/UpdateAxbBindFixedLine) operation
parameters.help_zh:
固话AXB隐私号的B号码。

B号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话请加区号，区号和固定电话中间不需要连字符。
如果您的业务需要修改已绑定的号码，可以调用UpdateAxbBindFixedLine (https://api.aliyun.com/document/Dyplsapi/2017-05-25/UpdateAxbBindFixedLine)接口进行修改
parameters.name: telb

parameters.help_en: The binding time. The format is yyyyMMddHHmmss. The time is in UTC+8 and uses the 24-hour clock
parameters.help_zh: 绑定时间，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制
parameters.name: subts

parameters.help_en:
The caller-side announcement code. This parameter is required for the fixed-line AXB privacy number service. The code must include announcements for three scenarios. Specify the codes in the order of "B->X, A->X, other numbers->X", separated by commas.

For example, "1,2,3" indicates that the announcement code for B->X is 1, the announcement code for A->X is 2, and the announcement code for other numbers->X is 3
parameters.help_zh:
主叫侧放音编码，固话AXB隐私号业务时必须设置。必须包含3个场景的编码。按照“B->X,A->X,其他号码->X”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2,3”表示B->X放音编号为1，A->X放音编号为2，其他号码->X放音编号为3
parameters.name: anucode

parameters.help_en:
The callee-side announcement code after the call is connected. The code must include announcements for two scenarios. Specify the codes in the order of "A as callee, B as callee", separated by commas.

For example, "1,2" indicates that the announcement code when Number A answers as the callee is 1, and the announcement code when Number B answers as the callee is 2
parameters.help_zh:
接通后被叫侧放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2”表示A号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为2
parameters.name: anucodecalled

parameters.help_en:
The caller-side announcement code after the call is connected. The code must include announcements for two scenarios. Specify the codes in the order of "A as callee, B as callee", separated by commas.

For example, "1,2" indicates that the caller-side announcement code when Number A is the callee is 1, and the caller-side announcement code when Number B is the callee is 2
parameters.help_zh:
接通后主叫侧的放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2”表示A号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为2
parameters.name: t_anucode_connect

parameters.help_en: The area code. You can specify the location of Number X (specified city -> provincial capital -> national routing). If you do not specify a location, a number is randomly assigned nationwide
parameters.help_zh: 区号。支持指定X号码归属地（指定城市->省会->全国路由）。不指定归属地，全国随机
parameters.name: areacode

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

0: The binding never expires.

Other values: If you specify another value, such as 60, the binding is valid for 60 seconds after Number X is successfully allocated. After 60 seconds, the binding is automatically unbound
parameters.help_zh:
过期时间，单位：秒，取值：

0：永不过期。

其他数值：传其它数值时，比如60s，分配X号码成功的60秒内，绑定有效，超过60s后，自动解绑
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: The external business extension field. This parameter is returned in the call record receipt message. The value cannot exceed 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。不能超过100个字符长度
parameters.name: remark

fields.help_en:
The call recording control. Valid values:

0 (default): Do not record the call.

1: Record the call.
After you enable call recording, you can play and download voice files in the call records. Recording files are billed at CNY 0.010 per minute
fields.help_zh:
录音控制。取值：

0（默认值）：不录音。

1：录音。
开启通话录音功能后，可在呼叫记录中播放和下载语音文件。录音文件按通话分钟计费0.010元/分钟
fields.name: callrecording

Code.description_zh:

false：失败

Success.title_zh: 是否处理成功  true-成功
